title: Building permit leads
description: Verified city open-data feeds. Chicago, Seattle, Austin, Los Angeles, New York City, New Orleans, and Cincinnati are live. An unknown source id returns an error row and is not billed.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Preset source ids. Leave empty to query every verified feed. Chicago, Seattle, Austin, and Los Angeles were checked on 2026-10-26. New York City, New Orleans, and Cincinnati were checked on 2026-11-11.

enumTitles: New York City DOB NOW approved permits (initial permits only)

dateFrom.title: Issued from
dateFrom.description: Keep permits issued on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default is 30 days before the run.

dateTo.title: Issued through
dateTo.description: Keep permits issued on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default is the run date.

permitTypes.title: Permit types
permitTypes.description: Optional. Matched as whole words against the permit type and description. Roof also matches reroof and shingle. Remodel matches remodel, renovation, alteration, addition, kitchen, bath, and interior. Leave empty for every type. Every row also carries a normalized permit_category.

minValue.title: Minimum value (USD)
minValue.description: Drop permits below this job value. Default 0 keeps every value, including rows the city left blank. A minimum above 0 drops blank values.

newSinceLastRun.title: Only new since last run
newSinceLastRun.description: Skip permits charged by an earlier run. Seen (source, permit_id) keys and their firstSeen time are kept in the named key-value store below, so they survive between runs. Skipped permits are not billed and do not count toward Max permits.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store that holds seen permits. Use a different name per saved task to keep separate feeds.

maxItems.title: Max permits
maxItems.description: Hard cap on permit rows pushed for this run, after filters, dedupe, and newSinceLastRun. Default 50, maximum 200. Status rows do not count toward this cap and are not billed.

maxRequests.title: Max HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Cap on requests, including robots.txt and a proxy retry. Default 24, maximum 80.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before each request after the first. Default 2, which covers the Crawl-delay of 1 on the SODA robots files. The pause jitters upward by up to 2 seconds.

maxSpendUsd.title: Max spend (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Stop charging when the next permit, proxy, or CAPTCHA event would pass this amount. Default 5, maximum 100. Later permit rows are saved and are not billed.

maxProxyCostUsd.title: Max proxy spend (USD)
maxProxyCostUsd.description: Cap on proxy events alone. Default 0, so a block pushes one blocked row and the run exits with no proxy retry. A direct request is always tried first. Above 0, one Apify Proxy retry is sent after a block when this cap and maxSpendUsd both still have room. There is no proxy rotation.

allowCaptcha.title: Allow CAPTCHA solving
allowCaptcha.description: Default false. When false, a challenge after the proxy retry pushes a blocked row and exits without a solve charge. When true, a solve is attempted only if the proxy retry is still a challenge and maxSpendUsd covers the captcha event. This Actor does not ship a paid solver, so an unconfigured solve pushes blocked and is not billed.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Kept for the shared Actor contract. This Actor does not launch a browser.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy group
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy group used only after a direct request is blocked. Leave Apify Proxy off so the first attempt stays direct. Empty groups use datacenter. Residential is used only when this field selects it.

proxyGroups.title: Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Optional group names, such as DATACENTER or RESIDENTIAL. Used after a block when proxyConfiguration has no apifyProxyGroups. The first request stays direct.
